    Qed.
  End CrossArgs.
End CrossFresh.

The Stuck Eliminators, Read Alike

The setting of ElimView.cross_elim_all, without its premise on the stuck eliminators, and the container's uniform parameters ub related to the view's instance cups at the group's u0.
Section CrossBot.
  #[local] Set Default Proof Using "All".
  Variable (VP : qname -> ind_decl -> Prop) (p : qname) (D : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (HP : valid_groups VP) (HPD : VP p D).
  Let Hvg := valid_groups_valid VP HP p D HPD.
  Let Hcv := containers_valid_of_groups VP HP p D HPD.
  Let HD := valid_group_valid _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hc := valid_group_closed _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hl := valid_group_lookup _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hdt := valid_group_typed _ _ Hvg.
  Let Hass := valid_group_ass _ _ Hvg.
  Variable (Γ : ctx) (RΓ : relation env).
  Hypotheses (HRΓ : EF Γ ≈ Γ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΓ) (HΓ : ⊨ Γ).
  Variable (RU : relation env).
  Hypothesis (HRU : EF ind_uparams D ≈ ind_uparams D ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RU).
  Variable (Us : list exp).
  Hypotheses (HUl : List.length Us = ind_nu D)
    (HUs : forall k N T, List.nth_error Us k = Some N -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D) Id Us) k = Some T ->
             Γ ⊨ N : T).
  Variable (C1 : env) (u0 : list domain).
  Hypotheses (HC11 : RΓ C1 C1) (HUC : ⟦ Us ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ u0).
  Variable (Bks : list eblock) (iA : nat).
  Hypothesis (HBk : valid_blocks p D Γ Us Bks iA).
  Let HBks := valid_blocks_has _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk.
  Let HMall := valid_blocks_mctx _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk.
  Let HAv := valid_blocks_motive _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk.
  Let nr := canon_nparams_rel D u0.
  Let ar := canon_args_rel D u0.
  Let dr := canon_doms_rel u0.
  Let G := grp_rel p D u0 nr ar dr.
  Let Rel := fun j ns m ns' m' =>
    per_head (List.nth j (blocks_motives Bks) a_True) (List.nth j (blocks_motives Bks) a_True)
      (env_args C1 (ns ++ m :: nil)) (env_args C1 (ns' ++ m' :: nil)).
  #[local] Abbreviation EB f := (f VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs C1 u0 HC11 HUC).
  #[local] Abbreviation u0_len' := (u0_len D Us HUl C1 u0 HUC).
  #[local] Abbreviation u0_gargs' := (EB u0_gargs).

  Variable (qc : qname) (D' : ind_decl) (m : nat) (Mm : imember) (k' : nat) (Is : list exp) (vm : list nat).
  Hypotheses (Hq : ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qc = Some D') (HMm : ind_member D m = Some Mm)
    (Hh : im_head Mm = mh_view qc k' Is vm).
  Variable (ρb : env) (VBb : list eblock) (ub : list domain).
  Hypotheses (HbB : forall i' Mi', ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> exists b, List.nth_error VBb i' = Some b)
    (HnmB : forall i' Mi' b, ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> List.nth_error VBb i' = Some b -> eb_nm b = S (im_nn Mi'))
    (HnaB : forall i' Mi' b, ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> List.nth_error VBb i' = Some b -> brs_names (im_cons Mi') (eb_brs b))
    (HarB : forall i' Mi' b c gs' n B, ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> List.nth_error VBb i' = Some b ->
              ind_con Mi' c = Some gs' -> In (c, n, B) (eb_brs b) -> n = (im_nn Mi' + List.length gs' + cargs_nrec gs')%nat).
  Hypothesis (Hmot_x : forall i' Mi' v bb ba u u' ns ns' x x', ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> List.nth_error vm i' = Some v ->
                List.nth_error VBb i' = Some bb -> List.nth_error Bks v = Some ba -> G v u u' ns ns' x x' ->
                exists a a', ⟦ eb_motive bb ⟧ env_args ρb (ns ++ x :: nil) ↘ a /\
                  ⟦ eb_motive ba ⟧ env_args C1 (ns' ++ x' :: nil) ↘ a' /\
                  DF a ≈ a' ∈ per_univ_elem iA ↘ Rel v ns x ns' x').
  Hypothesis (Hbr_x : forall i' Mi' v Mv bb ba c gs' gs nb na Bb Ba u u' bs bs' vs vs' w ihs hd k,
                ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> List.nth_error vm i' = Some v -> ind_member D v = Some Mv ->
                List.nth_error VBb i' = Some bb -> List.nth_error Bks v = Some ba ->
                ind_con Mi' c = Some gs' -> ind_con Mv c = Some gs ->
                brs_lookup (eb_brs bb) c = Some (nb, Bb) -> brs_lookup (eb_brs ba) c = Some (na, Ba) ->
                G v u u' (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs')
                  (d_con hd k c (bs ++ vs)) (d_con hd k c (bs' ++ vs')) ->
                cross_results_rel dr Rel v u u' C1 p u0 Bks
                  (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs') gs' gs vs vs' w ihs ->
                exists r r', ⟦ Bb ⟧ env_args ρb (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs ++ vs ++ w) ↘ r /\
                  ⟦ Ba ⟧ env_args C1 (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs' ++ vs' ++ ihs) ↘ r' /\
                  Rel v (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs) (d_con hd k c (bs ++ vs))
                    (List.skipn (im_unu D Mv) bs') (d_con hd k c (bs' ++ vs')) r r').
  Variable (cups : list domain).
  Hypotheses (Ecups : ⟦ Is ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ env_args nil u0 ↘ cups)
    (Hub : per_gargs (List.rev (ind_uparams D')) nil nil ub cups).
  #[local] Abbreviation XE f := (f VP p D HP HPD Γ RΓ HRΓ HΓ RU HRU Us HUl HUs C1 u0 HC11 HUC Bks iA HBk qc D' m Mm k' Is vm
     Hq HMm Hh ρb VBb ub HbB HnmB HnaB HarB Hmot_x Hbr_x).
  #[local] Abbreviation CF f := (f VP p D HP HPD m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups ub u0_gargs' u0_len' Ecups Hub).

The stuck eliminators at the member j of the group and the container's members the view takes to j.
  Definition cross_bot (j : nat) : Prop :=
    forall i' Mj hd k as1 as2 e e' w w' ns ns', List.nth_error vm i' = Some j -> ind_member D j = Some Mj ->
      G j w w' ns ns' (⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e') ->
      Dom d_elim ρb VBb qc ub i' as1 e ≈ d_elim C1 Bks p u0 j as2 e' ∈ per_bot.

The Recursive Results at a Neutral

An argument both nest through but the group read does not: the two eliminators at it, stuck at the members its shapes end in.
The recursive results at the arguments x and x' of the shapes t' (the container's) and t (the group's): the container's under its eliminator, the group's under its own, related as recursive results.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record cross_ih_pair (t t' : ptyp) (k : nat) (u u' pre pre' : list domain) (x x' : domain) : Prop :=
    mk_cross_ih_pair
    {
The container's recursive result
      cross_ih_pair_container : domain
      
The group's recursive result
    ; cross_ih_pair_group : domain
      
The container's, under its eliminator
    ; cross_ih_pair_container_eval : ⟦ih x of t' under qc ub VBb ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρb ↘ cross_ih_pair_container
      
The group's, under its own
    ; cross_ih_pair_group_eval : ⟦ih x' of t under p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ cross_ih_pair_group
      
They are related as recursive results
    ; cross_ih_pair_related : rec_result_rel dr Rel k u u' pre pre' t x x' cross_ih_pair_container cross_ih_pair_group }.

  Lemma cross_ih_neut : forall t t' k u u' pre pre' a1 a2 e e', shape_corr vm t' t ->
      rec_arg_rel p D (okr_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u u' pre pre' t (⇑ a1 e) (⇑ a2 e') ->
      cross_bot (ptyp_mem t) ->
      cross_ih_pair t t' k u u' pre pre' (⇑ a1 e) (⇑ a2 e').
  Proof.
    induction t as [j Ps | B t IH]; intros [j' Ps' | B' t'] * Hsc H Hbot; cbn in Hsc; try contradiction.
    - destruct (rec_arg_self_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H) as (bs & bs' & Eb & Eb' & _ & _ & Hr).
      pose proof Hr as Hr0.
      inversion Hr0 as [| jx Mj hdx kx nsx nsx' as1 as2 ex ex' ux ux' HM Href Hn L1 L2 Hs1 Hs2 He]; subst.
      destruct (XE cross_neut_elim j' j Mj hdx kx as1 as2 e e' u u' bs bs' Hsc HM Hr
                  (Hbot j' Mj hdx kx as1 as2 e e' u u' bs bs' Hsc HM Hr)) as (r & r' & Er & Er' & HR).
      apply (mk_cross_ih_pair _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ r r'); [ constructor; exact Er | constructor; exact Er' |].
      econstructor; [ exact Eb | exact Eb' | exact HR ].
    - apply (mk_cross_ih_pair _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (d_ihfn ρb VBb qc ub t' (⇑ a1 e)) (d_ihfn C1 Bks p u0 t (⇑ a2 e')));
        [ constructor | constructor |].
      constructor; intros c c' Hcc.
      destruct (rec_arg_pi_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H c c' Hcc) as (r & r' & Ea & Ea' & Hr).
      inversion Ea; subst; inversion Ea'; subst.
      destruct (IH t' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hsc Hr Hbot) as [ih ih' I1 I2 HI].
      econstructor; [ exact Ea | exact Ea' | econstructor; [ exact Ea | exact I1 ] | econstructor; [ exact Ea' | exact I2 ] | exact HI ].
  Qed.

The Fresh Recursive Results

A recursive argument both the group read and the two sides have: the fresh variables of the types of its recursive results, the container's by its shape t' under its motives, the group's by t under its own, related as recursive results.
The types of the recursive results at the arguments x and x' of the shapes t' and t, in ρ1 and ρ2: the container's under its motives, the group's under its own, their fresh variables related as recursive results.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record cross_ih_types (t t' : ptyp) (k : nat) (u u' pre pre' : list domain) (ρ1 ρ2 : env) (x x' : domain) : Prop :=
    mk_cross_ih_types
    {
The container's recursive result type
      cross_ih_types_container : domain
      
The group's recursive result type
    ; cross_ih_types_group : domain
      
The container's, under its motives
    ; cross_ih_types_container_eval : ⟦ihty x of t' under ρb (blocks_motives VBb) ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ1 ↘ cross_ih_types_container
      
The group's, under its own
    ; cross_ih_types_group_eval : ⟦ihty x' of t under C1 (blocks_motives Bks) ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ2 ↘ cross_ih_types_group
      
Their related neutrals are related as recursive results
    ; cross_ih_types_related : forall e2 e2', Dom e2 ≈ e2' ∈ per_bot ->
        rec_result_rel dr Rel k u u' pre pre' t x x' (⇑ cross_ih_types_container e2) (⇑ cross_ih_types_group e2') }.

  Lemma cross_ih_fresh : forall t t' k u u' pre pre' ρ1 ρ2 a1 a2 e e', shape_corr vm t' t ->
      rec_arg_rel p D (okr_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u u' pre pre' t (⇑ a1 e) (⇑ a2 e') ->
      shape_tops dr k pre t a1 a2 ->
      ⟦shty t' of qc ub ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ1 ↘ a1 -> ⟦shty t of p u0 ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ2 ↘ a2 ->
      (forall Mj, ind_member D (ptyp_mem t) = Some Mj -> List.length (ptyp_ps t') = im_nn Mj /\ List.length (ptyp_ps t) = im_nn Mj) ->
      cross_ih_types t t' k u u' pre pre' ρ1 ρ2 (⇑ a1 e) (⇑ a2 e').
  Proof.
    destruct (vg_canon p D Hvg u0 u0_gargs' u0_len') as [CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI].
    pose proof (nparams_rel_sym p D u0 _ _ _ Hass CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI) as tsym.
    induction t as [j Ps | B t IH]; intros [j' Ps' | B' t'] k u u' pre pre' ρ1 ρ2 a1 a2 e e' Hsc H Ht E1 E2 Hpl;
      cbn in Hsc; try contradiction.
    - inversion E1 as [Ps0 ρ0 bs1 j0 hd1 k1 pre1 ? ? Ebs1 Em1 |]; subst.
      inversion E2 as [Ps0 ρ0 bs2 j0 hd2 k2 pre2 ? ? Ebs2 Em2 |]; subst.
      destruct (rec_arg_self_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H) as (bs & bs' & Eb & Eb' & _ & _ & Hr).
      pose proof Hr as Hr0.
      inversion Hr0 as [| jx Mj hdx kx nsx nsx' as1 as2 ex ex' ux ux' HM Href Hn L1 L2 Hs1 Hs2 He]; subst.
      cbn in Hpl; destruct (Hpl _ HM) as [Hp1 Hp2].
      assert (Lb1 : List.length bs1 = im_nn Mj) by (rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ebs1); exact Hp1).
      assert (Lb2 : List.length bs2 = im_nn Mj) by (rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ebs2); exact Hp2).
      rewrite List.length_app in L1, L2.
      rewrite skipn_app_exact in Hs1 by lia; rewrite skipn_app_exact in Hs2 by lia.
      pose proof (ind_rel_idx p D u0 nr ar dr Hass CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hr Hs1 Hs2) as Hm1.
      destruct (XE cross_member j' j Hsc) as (Mj' & Mj0 & HMj' & Hvmb).
      pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as HMj0; rewrite HM in HMj0; injection HMj0 as <-.
      destruct (HbB _ _ HMj') as [bb Hbb]; destruct (HBks _ _ HM) as [ba Hba].
      destruct (Hmot_x j' Mj' j bb ba u u' bs1 bs2 _ _ HMj' Hsc Hbb Hba Hm1) as (h1 & h2 & Eh1 & Eh2 & HR).
      apply (mk_cross_ih_types _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2).
      + econstructor; [ exact Ebs1 | rewrite (nth_blocks_motives _ _ _ Hbb); exact Eh1 ].
      + econstructor; [ exact Ebs2 | rewrite (nth_blocks_motives _ _ _ Hba); exact Eh2 ].
      + intros e2 e2' He2; econstructor; [ exact Eb | exact Eb' |].
        apply (proj1 (XE self_motive_move j Mj u u' bs1 bs2 _ _ bs bs' HM Hm1 (tsym _ _ HM _ _ Hs1) (tsym _ _ HM _ _ Hs2) _ _)).
        exact (per_bot_then_per_elem HR He2).
    - inversion E1 as [| B0 ρ0 b1 t0 ? ? Eb1]; subst.
      inversion E2 as [| B0 ρ0 b2 t0 ? ? Eb2]; subst.
      inversion Ht as [| pre0 B0 t0 b0 ρ0 F0 b0' ρ0' F0' Htop Hnext]; subst.
      apply (mk_cross_ih_types _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
               (Πᵈ b1 (nil ↦ d_ihfam ρb (blocks_motives VBb) ρ1 t' (⇑ (Πᵈ b1 (nil ↦ d_shfam qc ub ρ1 t') fam_cod) e)) fam_cod)
               (Πᵈ b2 (nil ↦ d_ihfam C1 (blocks_motives Bks) ρ2 t (⇑ (Πᵈ b2 (nil ↦ d_shfam p u0 ρ2 t) fam_cod) e')) fam_cod));
        [ econstructor; exact Eb1 | econstructor; exact Eb2 |].
      intros e2 e2' He2; constructor; intros c c' Hcc.
      destruct (rec_arg_pi_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H c c' Hcc) as (r & r' & Ea & Ea' & Hr).
      inversion Ea; subst.
      match goal with Ex0 : ⟦ fam_cod ⟧ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ↦ c ↘ _ |- _ => rename Ex0 into Ex end.
      inversion Ea'; subst.
      match goal with Ex0 : ⟦ fam_cod ⟧ _ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ↦ c' ↘ _ |- _ => rename Ex0 into Ex' end.
      pose proof (fam_cod_shfam_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ Ex) as Sx.
      pose proof (fam_cod_shfam_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ Ex') as Sx'.
      cbn in Hpl.
      destruct (IH t' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hsc Hr (Hnext _ _ _ _ Hcc Ex Ex') Sx Sx' Hpl) as [h1 h2 I1 I2 HI].
      econstructor; [ exact Ea | exact Ea'
                    | eapply eval_app_neut, eval_fam_cod_ihfam; [ exact Ea | exact I1 ]
                    | eapply eval_app_neut, eval_fam_cod_ihfam; [ exact Ea' | exact I2 ] |].
      apply HI, per_bot_app; [ exact He2 | exact (Htop _ _ Hcc) ].
  Qed.

The Recursive Results of a Branch

The arguments vA of a container's constructor (kinds gA) and vB of the group's (kinds gB), of kinds gq in the group read: the fresh recursive results on each side where gq has the argument recursive, the wrapped results the branches are read under, and those related as cross_results_rel has them.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record cross_wrapped (k : nat) (pre pre' : list domain) (gq gA gB : list carg) (vA vB : list domain) (ρA ρB : env)
      (s2 : nat) : Prop := mk_cross_wrapped
    {
The container's fresh recursive results
      cross_wrapped_ihsA : list domain
      
The group's fresh recursive results
    ; cross_wrapped_ihsB : list domain
      
The container's wrapped results
    ; cross_wrapped_wA : list domain
      
The group's wrapped results
    ; cross_wrapped_wB : list domain
      
The container's fresh results
    ; cross_wrapped_fresh_a : Fihs vA at gq gA under ρb (blocks_motives VBb) in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρA ⍮ s2 ↘ cross_wrapped_ihsA
      
The group's fresh results
    ; cross_wrapped_fresh_b : Fihs vB at gq gB under C1 (blocks_motives Bks) in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρB ⍮ s2 ↘ cross_wrapped_ihsB
      
The container's wrapped results, from them
    ; cross_wrapped_wrap_a : ⟦wihs vA of gq gA with cross_wrapped_ihsA under qc ub VBb ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρb ↘ cross_wrapped_wA
      
The group's wrapped results, from them
    ; cross_wrapped_wrap_b : ⟦wihs vB of gq gB with cross_wrapped_ihsB under p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ cross_wrapped_wB
      
The wrapped results are related
    ; cross_wrapped_related : cross_results_rel dr Rel k u0 u0 C1 p u0 Bks pre pre' gA gB vA vB cross_wrapped_wA cross_wrapped_wB }.

  Lemma cross_wrapped_results : forall (rk : nat -> nat) r, (forall j', rk j' < r -> cross_bot j') ->
      forall k gq gA gB vA vB pre pre' ρA ρB s s2,
        cargs_kinds gq gA -> cargs_corr vm gA gB -> cargs_nest_ok rk r gq gB -> cargs_plen D' gA -> cargs_plen D gB ->
        con_args_rel p D (okr_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u0 u0 pre pre' gB vA vB ->
        cross_tops dr k pre gA gB vA vB ->
        Fcargs gA of qc ub in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρA ⍮ s ↘ vA -> Fcargs gB of p u0 in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρB ⍮ s ↘ vB ->
        cross_wrapped k pre pre' gq gA gB vA vB ρA ρB s2.
  Proof.
    intros rk r HIH k.
    induction gq as [| g' gq IH]; intros [| gA0 gA] [| gB0 gB] vA vB pre pre' ρA ρB s s2 Hk Hco Hno PA PB Hca Ht FA FB;
      cbn in Hk, Hco; try contradiction;
      try (destruct g'; cbn in Hk; contradiction); try (destruct gA0; cbn in Hk, Hco; contradiction).
    - inversion FA; inversion FB; subst.
      apply (mk_cross_wrapped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ nil nil nil nil); constructor.
    - pose proof (cargs_plen_tail _ _ _ PA) as PA'; pose proof (cargs_plen_tail _ _ _ PB) as PB'.
      destruct g' as [T' | t''], gA0 as [A' | t'], gB0 as [A | t]; cbn in Hk, Hco, Hno; try contradiction.
      +
Non-recursive throughout.
        destruct (fresh_cargs_arg_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ FA) as (aA & vA' & -> & EaA & FA').
        destruct (fresh_cargs_arg_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ FB) as (aB & vB' & -> & EaB & FB').
        destruct (IH gA gB vA' vB' (pre ++ ⇑! aA s :: nil) (pre' ++ ⇑! aB s :: nil) _ _ (S s) s2 Hk Hco Hno PA' PB'
                    (con_args_arg_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hca) (cross_tops_arg_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ht) FA' FB')
          as [ihsA ihsB wA wB IA IB WA WB HR].
        apply (mk_cross_wrapped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ihsA ihsB wA wB).
        * apply fresh_ihs_arg; exact IA.
        * apply fresh_ihs_arg; exact IB.
        * apply wrap_ihs_eval_arg; exact WA.
        * apply wrap_ihs_eval_arg; exact WB.
        * apply cross_results_arg; exact HR.
      +
Nested through by the group only: the group's eliminator at its argument.
        destruct (fresh_cargs_arg_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ FA) as (aA & vA' & -> & EaA & FA').
        destruct (fresh_cargs_rec_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ FB) as (aB & vB' & -> & EaB & FB').
        destruct (con_args_rec_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hca) as [Hrr Hc'].
        destruct (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (XE self_elim_all))) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hrr) as (ih0 & ih & _ & Ih & _).
        destruct Hno as [_ Hno].
        destruct (IH gA gB vA' vB' pre pre' _ _ (S s) s2 Hk Hco Hno PA' PB' Hc' (cross_tops_nest_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ht) FA' FB')
          as [ihsA ihsB wA wB IA IB WA WB HR].
        apply (mk_cross_wrapped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ihsA ihsB wA (ih :: wB)).
        * apply fresh_ihs_arg; exact IA.
        * apply fresh_ihs_nest; exact IB.
        * apply wrap_ihs_eval_arg; exact WA.
        * eapply wrap_ihs_eval_nest; [ exact Ih | exact WB ].
        * eapply cross_results_nest; [ exact Ih | exact HR ].
      +
Nested through by both: the eliminators at a member of lower rank.
        destruct (fresh_cargs_rec_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ FA) as (aA & vA' & -> & EaA & FA').
        destruct (fresh_cargs_rec_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ FB) as (aB & vB' & -> & EaB & FB').
        destruct (con_args_rec_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hca) as [Hrr Hc'].
        destruct (cross_tops_rec_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ht) as [_ Ht'].
        destruct Hco as (Hmt & Hdp & Hco); destruct Hno as [Hlt Hno].
        pose proof (shape_corr_of _ _ _ Hmt Hdp) as Hsc.
        destruct (cross_ih_neut t t' k u0 u0 pre pre' aA aB (d_var s) (d_var s) Hsc Hrr (HIH _ Hlt)) as [ih ih' I1 I2 HI].
        destruct (IH gA gB vA' vB' pre pre' _ _ (S s) s2 Hk Hco Hno PA' PB' Hc' Ht' FA' FB')
          as [ihsA ihsB wA wB IA IB WA WB HR].
        apply (mk_cross_wrapped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ihsA ihsB (ih :: wA) (ih' :: wB)).
        * apply fresh_ihs_nest; exact IA.
        * apply fresh_ihs_nest; exact IB.
        * eapply wrap_ihs_eval_nest; [ exact I1 | exact WA ].
        * eapply wrap_ihs_eval_nest; [ exact I2 | exact WB ].
        * eapply cross_results_rec; [ exact HI | exact HR ].
      +
Recursive throughout: the fresh recursive results.
        destruct (fresh_cargs_rec_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ FA) as (aA & vA' & -> & EaA & FA').
        destruct (fresh_cargs_rec_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ FB) as (aB & vB' & -> & EaB & FB').
        destruct (con_args_rec_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hca) as [Hrr Hc'].
        destruct (cross_tops_rec_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ht) as [Hts Ht'].
        destruct Hco as (Hmt & Hdp & Hco).
        pose proof (shape_corr_of _ _ _ Hmt Hdp) as Hsc.
        assert (Hpl : forall Mj, ind_member D (ptyp_mem t) = Some Mj ->
                   List.length (ptyp_ps t') = im_nn Mj /\ List.length (ptyp_ps t) = im_nn Mj).
        { intros Mj HMj.
          destruct (PA nil t' gA eq_refl) as (Mj' & HMj' & Hl').
          destruct (PB nil t gB eq_refl) as (Mj0 & HMj0 & Hl0).
          rewrite HMj in HMj0; injection HMj0 as <-.
          destruct (XE cross_member _ _ Hmt) as (Mi2 & Mj2 & HMi2 & Hvmb).
          rewrite HMj' in HMi2; injection HMi2 as <-.
          pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as HMj2; rewrite HMj in HMj2; injection HMj2 as <-.
          pose proof (view_member_nn _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as Hnn.
          split; lia. }
        destruct (cross_ih_fresh t t' k u0 u0 pre pre' ρA ρB aA aB (d_var s) (d_var s) Hsc Hrr Hts EaA EaB Hpl)
          as [h1 h2 G1 G2 HG].
        destruct (IH gA gB vA' vB' pre pre' _ _ (S s) (S s2) Hk Hco Hno PA' PB' Hc' Ht' FA' FB')
          as [ihsA ihsB wA wB IA IB WA WB HR].
        apply (mk_cross_wrapped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (⇑! h1 s2 :: ihsA) (⇑! h2 s2 :: ihsB) (⇑! h1 s2 :: wA) (⇑! h2 s2 :: wB)).
        * econstructor; [ exact G1 | exact IA ].
        * econstructor; [ exact G2 | exact IB ].
        * apply wrap_ihs_eval_rec; exact WA.
        * apply wrap_ihs_eval_rec; exact WB.
        * eapply cross_results_rec; [ exact (HG _ _ var_per_bot) | exact HR ].
  Qed.

A Block

A block of the two stuck eliminators, the one of the member Mn of the group read: the container's member a its selection sela gives, the group's member b selb gives, b the member the view takes a to; Mn's constructors are a's, their arguments of kinds compatible with a's, and nested through by b only at members of rank below r; the two members' types at a common reference.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record cross_block_site (rk : nat -> nat) (r : nat) (sela selb : option (list nat)) (n : nat) (Mn : imember) : Prop :=
    mk_cross_block_site
    {
The container's member index
      cross_block_site_a : nat
      
The container's member
    ; cross_block_site_Ma : imember
      
The group's member index
    ; cross_block_site_b : nat
      
The group's member
    ; cross_block_site_Mb : imember
      
The common reference's group
    ; cross_block_site_hd : qname
      
The common reference's member
    ; cross_block_site_k : nat
      
The container side's uniform parameters at the reference
    ; cross_block_site_prea : list domain
      
The group side's uniform parameters at the reference
    ; cross_block_site_preb : list domain
      
sela gives a
    ; cross_block_site_src_a : elim_src sela n = cross_block_site_a
      
selb gives b
    ; cross_block_site_src_b : elim_src selb n = cross_block_site_b
      
The view takes a to b
    ; cross_block_site_in_view_map : List.nth_error vm cross_block_site_a = Some cross_block_site_b
      
a is a member of the container
    ; cross_block_site_member_a : ind_member D' cross_block_site_a = Some cross_block_site_Ma
      
b is a member of the group
    ; cross_block_site_member_b : ind_member D cross_block_site_b = Some cross_block_site_Mb
      
Mn has a's non-uniform parameter count
    ; cross_block_site_nn : im_nn Mn = im_nn cross_block_site_Ma
      
Mn's constructors are a's
    ; cross_block_site_names : List.map fst (im_cons Mn) = List.map fst (im_cons cross_block_site_Ma)
      
Their argument kinds are compatible with a's
    ; cross_block_site_kinds : forall c gq gA, In (c, gq) (im_cons Mn) -> ind_con cross_block_site_Ma c = Some gA -> cargs_kinds gq gA
      
b nests through only at members of rank below r
    ; cross_block_site_nest : forall c gq gB, In (c, gq) (im_cons Mn) -> ind_con cross_block_site_Mb c = Some gB -> cargs_nest_ok rk r gq gB
      
a's type at ub is at the reference
    ; cross_block_site_ref_a : ⟦mref cross_block_site_a of qc ub ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (cross_block_site_hd, cross_block_site_k, cross_block_site_prea)
      
b's type at u0 is at the reference
    ; cross_block_site_ref_b : ⟦mref cross_block_site_b of p u0 ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (cross_block_site_hd, cross_block_site_k, cross_block_site_preb) }.

  Lemma cross_block_read : forall (rk : nat -> nat) r, (forall j', rk j' < r -> cross_bot j') ->
      forall s sela selb n Mn, cross_block_site rk r sela selb n Mn ->
        block_read_pair qc D' ub VBb ρb p D u0 Bks C1 s sela selb n Mn.
  Proof.
    intros rk r HIH s sela selb n Mn [a Ma b Mb hd k prea preb Hsa Hsb Hvab HMa HMb Hnn Hnames Hkinds Hnest Ra Rb].
    pose proof (valid_groups_containers VP HP p D m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HPD HMm Hh Hq) as HVQ.
    pose proof (valid_groups_valid VP HP qc D' HVQ) as HgQ.
    pose proof (length_cups p D Hvg m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups Ecups) as Hlc.
    assert (Hlb : List.length ub = ind_nu D') by (destruct (per_gargs_length _ _ _ _ _ Hub) as [H1 _]; lia).
    pose proof (uparams_refl_l D' (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ) (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) _ _ Hub) as Hubub.
    destruct (XE cross_member a b Hvab) as (Ma0 & Mb0 & HMa0 & Hvmb).
    rewrite HMa in HMa0; injection HMa0 as <-.
    pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as HMb0; rewrite HMb in HMb0; injection HMb0 as <-.
    destruct (mref_ref_len qc D' a Ma ub hd k prea Hq HMa Hlb Ra) as [Hra Hla].
    destruct (mref_ref_len p D b Mb u0 hd k preb Hl HMb u0_len' Rb) as [Hrb Hlb'].
    pose proof (view_member_unu _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as Hunu.
    pose proof (view_member_nn _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as Hnn'.
    destruct (grp_tele_ass_vwrap _ Hass _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hh) as (D2 & Hq2 & Hvw).
    rewrite Hq in Hq2; injection Hq2 as <-.
    destruct (vwrap_ok_members _ _ _ Hvw a Ma b HMa Hvab) as (Mb1 & HMb1 & _ & HnamesAB & _).
    rewrite HMb in HMb1; injection HMb1 as <-.
    destruct (HbB _ _ HMa) as [blA HblA]; destruct (HBks _ _ HMb) as [blB HblB].
    destruct (fresh_nparams_exist qc D' HgQ ub Hubub Hlb a Ma s HMa) as (nsA & FnsA & HnsA).
    destruct (fresh_nparams_exist p D Hvg u0 u0_gargs' u0_len' b Mb s HMb) as (nsB & FnsB & _).
    pose proof (CF cross_fresh_nparams a Ma b Mb HMa Hvab HMb s nsA nsB FnsA FnsB) as Hcp.
    pose proof Hcp as [Hns HpA HpC HpG].
    destruct (vg_canon p D Hvg u0 u0_gargs' u0_len') as [CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI].
    pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_l p D u0 _ _ _ Hass CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI _ _ HMb _ _ Hns) as HAA.
    pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_r p D u0 _ _ _ Hass CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI _ _ HMb _ _ Hns) as HBB.
    pose proof Hns as Hns0; rewrite tele_rel_iff in Hns0; destruct Hns0 as (LnA & LnB & _).
    rewrite List.length_rev, length_im_nparams in LnA, LnB.
    assert (Lpa : List.length prea = im_unu D Mb) by lia.
The motives at the fresh neutral.
    assert (Hneu : G b u0 u0 nsA nsB (⇑! (d_ind hd k (prea ++ nsA)) (s + im_nn Mn)) (⇑! (d_ind hd k (preb ++ nsB)) (s + im_nn Mn))).
    { eapply ind_rel_neut; [ exact HMb | exact Hrb | exact Hns | | | | | exact var_per_bot ].
      - rewrite List.length_app; lia.
      - rewrite List.length_app; lia.
      - rewrite skipn_app_exact by exact Lpa; exact HAA.
      - rewrite skipn_app_exact by exact Hlb'; exact HBB. }
    destruct (Hmot_x a Ma b blA blB u0 u0 nsA nsB _ _ HMa Hvab HblA HblB Hneu) as (aa & ab & Ea & Eb & HR).
    apply (mk_block_read_pair qc D' ub VBb ρb p D u0 Bks C1 s sela selb n Mn Ma Mb blA blB hd k prea preb nsA nsB aa ab).
    - rewrite Hsa; exact HMa.
    - rewrite Hsb; exact HMb.
    - rewrite Hsa; exact HblA.
    - rewrite Hsb; exact HblB.
    - rewrite (HnmB _ _ _ HMa HblA), Hnn; reflexivity.
    - rewrite (valid_blocks_nm _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk _ _ _ HMb HblB), Hnn', Hnn; reflexivity.
    - rewrite Hsa; exact Ra.
    - rewrite Hsb; exact Rb.
    - exact FnsA.
    - exact FnsB.
    - exact Ea.
    - exact Eb.
    - exact (per_univ_then_per_top_typ HR).
    - pose proof (HnaB _ _ _ HMa HblA) as Hn0; unfold brs_names in *; rewrite Hnames; exact Hn0.
    - pose proof (valid_blocks_names _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk _ _ _ HMb HblB) as Hn0; unfold brs_names in *; rewrite Hnames, <- HnamesAB; exact Hn0.
    -
A branch.
      intros c gq na Ba nb Bb Hin InA InB.
      assert (HinA : In c (List.map fst (im_cons Ma)))
        by (rewrite <- Hnames; apply List.in_map_iff; exists (c, gq); split; [ reflexivity | exact Hin ]).
      destruct (cons_lookup_names _ _ HinA) as [gsA HcA].
      destruct (view_member_cons _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb c gsA HcA) as (gsB & HcB & Hcorr).
      pose proof (Hkinds c gq gsA Hin HcA) as Hkd.
      pose proof (Hnest c gq gsB Hin HcB) as Hno.
      pose proof (grp_tele_ass_plen _ (valid_group_ass _ _ HgQ) _ _ _ _ HMa (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ HcA)) as PA.
      pose proof (grp_tele_ass_plen _ Hass _ _ _ _ HMb (cons_lookup_in _ _ _ HcB)) as PB.
      assert (K1 : per_gargs (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc D' Ma nil ++ im_params D' Ma)) nil nil (ub ++ nsA ++ nil) (cups ++ nsB ++ nil))
        by (cbn [cargs_ctx cargs_ctx_aux List.app]; rewrite !List.app_nil_r; exact HpA).
      assert (K2 : per_gargs (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc D' Ma nil ++ im_params D' Ma)) nil nil (cups ++ nsB ++ nil) (cups ++ nsB ++ nil))
        by (cbn [cargs_ctx cargs_ctx_aux List.app]; rewrite !List.app_nil_r; exact HpC).
      assert (K3 : per_gargs (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mb nil ++ im_params D Mb)) nil nil (u0 ++ nsB ++ nil) (u0 ++ nsB ++ nil))
        by (cbn [cargs_ctx cargs_ctx_aux List.app]; rewrite !List.app_nil_r; exact HpG).
      destruct (CF cross_fresh_cargs a Ma b Mb HMa Hvab HMb c gsA gsB HcA HcB Hcorr nsA nsB Hcp HnsA gsA gsB nil nil nil nil
                  eq_refl eq_refl I eq_refl eq_refl K1 K2 K3 (tele_prefix_rel_nil _) (tele_prefix_rel_nil _)
                  (tele_prefix_rel_nil _) (s + im_nn Mn))
        as [vsA vsB FA FB Hca Hnr Ht].
      cbn [nonrec_arg_vals List.length cargs_nonrec] in FA, FB, Hca, Hnr, Ht.
      rewrite !List.app_nil_r in FA; rewrite !List.app_nil_r in FB; rewrite !List.app_nil_r in Hca;
        rewrite !List.app_nil_r in Ht.
      destruct (cross_wrapped_results rk r HIH b gq gsA gsB vsA vsB nsA nsB _ _ (s + im_nn Mn) (s + im_nn Mn + List.length gq)
                  Hkd Hcorr Hno PA PB Hca Ht FA FB)
        as [ihsA ihsB wA wB IA IB WA WB HCR].
      pose proof (con_args_rel_len _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hca) as [LvA LvB].
The constructors on each side, related.
      assert (HG : G b u0 u0 nsA nsB (d_con hd k c ((prea ++ nsA) ++ vsA)) (d_con hd k c ((preb ++ nsB) ++ vsB))).
      { eapply ind_rel_con; [ exact HMb | exact Hrb | exact Hns | exact HcB | | | | | | ].
        - rewrite List.length_app; lia.
        - rewrite List.length_app; lia.
        - rewrite skipn_app_exact by exact Lpa; exact HAA.
        - rewrite skipn_app_exact by exact Hlb'; exact HBB.
        - rewrite skipn_app_exact by exact Lpa; split; [ apply length_nonrec_arg_vals; exact LvA | exact Hnr ].
        - rewrite !skipn_app_exact by assumption; exact Hca. }
      assert (HnA : List.NoDup (List.map (fun b0 => fst (fst b0)) (eb_brs blA))).
      { pose proof (HnaB _ _ _ HMa HblA) as Hn0; unfold brs_names in Hn0; rewrite <- Hn0.
        exact (decl_typed_nodup _ _ _ (valid_group_typed _ _ HgQ) _ _ HMa). }
      assert (HnB : List.NoDup (List.map (fun b0 => fst (fst b0)) (eb_brs blB))).
      { pose proof (valid_blocks_names _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk _ _ _ HMb HblB) as Hn0; unfold brs_names in Hn0; rewrite <- Hn0.
        exact (decl_typed_nodup _ _ _ Hdt _ _ HMb). }
      destruct (Hbr_x a Ma b Mb blA blB c gsA gsB na nb Ba Bb u0 u0 (prea ++ nsA) (preb ++ nsB) vsA vsB wA wB hd k
                  HMa Hvab HMb HblA HblB HcA HcB (brs_lookup_nodup_in _ _ _ _ HnA InA) (brs_lookup_nodup_in _ _ _ _ HnB InB))
        as (ra & rb & Era & Erb & Hrr).
      { rewrite !skipn_app_exact by assumption; exact HG. }
      { rewrite !skipn_app_exact by assumption; exact HCR. }
      rewrite skipn_app_exact in Era by exact Lpa; rewrite skipn_app_exact in Erb by exact Hlb'.
      rewrite skipn_app_exact in Hrr by exact Lpa; rewrite skipn_app_exact in Hrr by exact Hlb'.
      destruct (Hmot_x a Ma b blA blB u0 u0 nsA nsB _ _ HMa Hvab HblA HblB HG) as (ta & tb & Ta & Tb & HT).
      rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in Ta, Tb.
      apply (mk_branch_read_pair qc D' ub VBb ρb p D u0 Bks C1 s Mn hd k prea preb Ma Mb (eb_motive blA) (eb_motive blB)
               nsA nsB c gq na nb Ba Bb gsA gsB vsA vsB ihsA ihsB wA wB ra rb ta tb).
      + exact HcA.
      + exact HcB.
      + rewrite (HarB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMa HblA HcA InA), (cargs_kinds_length _ _ Hkd), Hnn; reflexivity.
      + rewrite (valid_blocks_arity _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMb HblB HcB InB), (cargs_kinds_length _ _ Hkd),
          (cargs_corr_len _ _ _ Hcorr), Hnn', Hnn; reflexivity.
      + exact PA.
      + exact PB.
      + exact FA.
      + exact FB.
      + exact IA.
      + exact IB.
      + exact WA.
      + exact WB.
      + exact Era.
      + exact Erb.
      + exact Ta.
      + exact Tb.
      + rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in Hrr, HT; exact (per_elem_then_per_top HT Hrr).
  Qed.

The References of the Two Sides

A container's member a and the group's member b the view takes it to: their types at ub and at u0 are at a common reference.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record cross_ref_pair (a b : nat) : Prop := mk_cross_ref_pair
    {
The common reference's group
      cross_ref_pair_hd : qname
      
The common reference's member
    ; cross_ref_pair_k : nat
      
a's uniform parameters at the reference
    ; cross_ref_pair_prea : list domain
      
b's uniform parameters at the reference
    ; cross_ref_pair_preb : list domain
      
a's type at ub is at the reference
    ; cross_ref_pair_ref_a : ⟦mref a of qc ub ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (cross_ref_pair_hd, cross_ref_pair_k, cross_ref_pair_prea)
      
b's type at u0 is at the reference
    ; cross_ref_pair_ref_b : ⟦mref b of p u0 ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (cross_ref_pair_hd, cross_ref_pair_k, cross_ref_pair_preb) }.

  Lemma cross_refs : forall a Ma b Mb, List.nth_error vm a = Some b -> ind_member D' a = Some Ma -> ind_member D b = Some Mb ->
      cross_ref_pair a b.
  Proof.
    intros a Ma b Mb Hvab HMa HMb.
    pose proof (valid_groups_containers VP HP p D m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HPD HMm Hh Hq) as HVQ.
    pose proof (valid_groups_valid VP HP qc D' HVQ) as HgQ.
    pose proof (length_cups p D Hvg m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups Ecups) as Hlc.
    assert (Hlb : List.length ub = ind_nu D') by (destruct (per_gargs_length _ _ _ _ _ Hub) as [H1 _]; lia).
    pose proof (uparams_refl_l D' (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ) (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) _ _ Hub) as Hubub.
    destruct (XE cross_member a b Hvab) as (Ma0 & Mb0 & HMa0 & Hvmb).
    rewrite HMa in HMa0; injection HMa0 as <-.
    pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as HMb0; rewrite HMb in HMb0; injection HMb0 as <-.
    destruct (mref_exists VP HP qc D' HVQ ub Hubub Hlb a Ma HMa) as [[[hda ka] prea] Ra].
    destruct (mref_exists VP HP p D HPD u0 u0_gargs' u0_len' b Mb HMb) as [[[hdb kb] preb] Rb].
    destruct (mref_ref_len qc D' a Ma ub hda ka prea Hq HMa Hlb Ra) as [Hra _].
    destruct (mref_ref_len p D b Mb u0 hdb kb preb Hl HMb u0_len' Rb) as [Hrb _].
    pose proof (view_member_ref _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as Href.
    rewrite Hra, Hrb in Href; injection Href as <- <-.
    exact (mk_cross_ref_pair a b hdb kb prea preb Ra Rb).
  Qed.

The Uniform Parameters the Two Sides Read

At a declared member of the container, its own ub and k's instance cups; at a view of the container's, its instance at ub and the group's view's at u0, which the view equations relate.
  Lemma cross_uparams_read : forall i' Mi' j Mj hd k prea preb Dq, List.nth_error vm i' = Some j ->
      ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> ind_member D j = Some Mj ->
      ⟦mref i' of qc ub ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k, prea) -> ⟦mref j of p u0 ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k, preb) ->
      ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack hd = Some Dq ->
      per_top_ps (List.rev (ind_uparams Dq)) prea preb.
  Proof.
    intros i' Mi' j Mj hd k prea preb Dq Hvi HMi' HMj Ra Rb HDq.
    pose proof (length_cups p D Hvg m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups Ecups) as Hlc.
    assert (Hlb : List.length ub = ind_nu D') by (destruct (per_gargs_length _ _ _ _ _ Hub) as [H1 _]; lia).
    destruct (grp_tele_ass_vm _ Hass _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hh Hq HMi') as [jj Mjj Hvj HMjj _ Hhm].
    rewrite Hvi in Hvj; injection Hvj as <-; rewrite HMj in HMjj; injection HMjj as <-.
    destruct (im_head Mi') as [pm | qv kv Iv vmv] eqn:Hh'.
    - destruct Hhm as [vm' Hhj].
      pose proof (mref_decl_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq HMi' Hh' Ra) as Heq; injection Heq as -> -> ->.
      destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMj Hhj Rb) as (py & Heq & Epy); injection Heq as ->.
      pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Epy Ecups) as ->.
      rewrite Hq in HDq; injection HDq as <-.
      intros s; exact (per_gargs_top _ _ _ _ _ Hub ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; unfold ind_nu in Hlb; exact Hlb) s).
    - destruct Hhm as (Is' & vm' & Hhj & _).
      destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq HMi' Hh' Ra) as (pa & Heq & Epa); injection Heq as -> -> ->.
      destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMj Hhj Rb) as (pb & Heq & Epb); injection Heq as ->.
      destruct (view_view_values VP HP p D HPD m Mm qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' j qv kv Iv vmv Dq Mj Is' vm'
                  HMm Hh Hq HMi' Hh' HDq Hvi HMj Hhj u0 cups ub u0_gargs' u0_len' Ecups Hub) as (pa' & pb' & Epa' & Epb' & Hgp).
      pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Epa' Epa) as ->; pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Epb' Epb) as ->.
      pose proof (valid_groups_containers VP HP p D m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HPD HMm Hh Hq) as HVQ.
      destruct (grp_tele_ass_views _ (valid_group_ass _ _ (valid_groups_valid VP HP qc D' HVQ)) _ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' Hh') as (D3 & Mc3 & Hq3 & _ & _ & HlIv).
      rewrite HDq in Hq3; injection Hq3 as <-.
      assert (Lp : List.length pa = List.length (List.rev (ind_uparams Dq)))
        by (rewrite List.length_rev, (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Epa); exact HlIv).
      intros s; exact (per_gargs_top _ _ _ _ _ Hgp Lp s).
  Qed.

The Stuck Eliminators at a Member

The group's member j the view takes the container's i' to is a view, of i''s container, at the map the agreement of the views' maps gives (view_maps_coherent): the blocks the two read for each member of the group read are the container's at its member and the group's at the member the view takes it to. Its recursive results at the arguments it nests through are at members of lower rank.
  Lemma cross_bot_rank : forall rk, view_rank_ok gc_deps gc_stack D rk ->
      forall j, (forall j', rk j' < rk j -> cross_bot j') -> cross_bot j.
  Proof.
    intros rk Hrk j HIH i' Mj hd k as1 as2 e e' w w' ns ns' Hvi HM Hg0.
    pose proof (valid_groups_containers VP HP p D m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HPD HMm Hh Hq) as HVQ.
    pose proof (valid_groups_valid VP HP qc D' HVQ) as HgQ.
    pose proof (containers_valid_of_groups VP HP qc D' HVQ) as HcvQ.
    pose proof (length_cups p D Hvg m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups Ecups) as Hlc.
    assert (Hlb : List.length ub = ind_nu D') by (destruct (per_gargs_length _ _ _ _ _ Hub) as [H1 _]; lia).
    pose proof Hg0 as Hg1.
    inversion Hg1 as [| j0 Mj0 hd0 k0 ns0 ns0' as1' as2' e0 e0' w0 w0' HM0 Hr Hn L1 L2 Hs1 Hs2 He]; subst.
    rewrite HM in HM0; injection HM0 as <-.
    destruct (XE cross_member i' j Hvi) as (Mi' & Mj1 & HMi' & Hvmb).
    pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as HMj1; rewrite HM in HMj1; injection HMj1 as <-.
    pose proof (view_member_ref _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as Href; rewrite Hr in Href; symmetry in Href.
    destruct (XE self_ref_target j Mj hd k HM Hr) as (Dq & Mk & HDq & HMk & Hnnq & Hnuq).
    destruct (cross_refs i' Mi' j Mj Hvi HMi' HM) as [hd1 k1 prea preb Ra Rb].
    destruct (mref_ref_len qc D' i' Mi' ub hd1 k1 prea Hq HMi' Hlb Ra) as [Hra _].
    rewrite Href in Hra; injection Hra as <- <-.
    apply (per_bot_elim_pair qc D' ub VBb ρb p D u0 Bks C1 Hq Hl i' Mi' j Mj hd k Dq Mk as1 as2 e e' prea preb
             HMi' HM Href Hr HDq HMk).
    - unfold im_np; lia.
    - unfold im_np; lia.
    - intros i0 Mi0 b HMi0 Hb; exact (HnmB _ _ _ HMi0 Hb).
    - intros i0 Mi0 b HMi0 Hb; exact (valid_blocks_nm _ _ _ _ _ _ HBk _ _ _ HMi0 Hb).
    - exact Ra.
    - exact Rb.
    - exact (cross_uparams_read i' Mi' j Mj hd k prea preb Dq Hvi HMi' HM Ra Rb HDq).
    - exact He.
    -
The blocks.
      intros s n Mn HMn.
      apply (cross_block_read rk (rk j) HIH s).
      destruct (grp_tele_ass_vm _ Hass _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hh Hq HMi') as [jj Mjj Hvj HMjj _ Hhm].
      rewrite Hvi in Hvj; injection Hvj as <-; rewrite HM in HMjj; injection HMjj as <-.
      pose proof (grp_tele_ass_view_maps_coherent _ Hass) as Hcoh.
      destruct (im_head Mi') as [pm | qv kv Iv vmv] eqn:Hh'.
      +
A declared member of the container: the view's own map.
        destruct Hhm as [vm' Hhj].
        pose proof (Hcoh m Mm qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' j Mj qc i' Is vm' HMm Hh Hq HMi' Hvi HM Hhj) as Hvma.
        unfold view_map_at in Hvma; rewrite Hh' in Hvma; subst vm'.
        assert (Hsa : im_sel Mi' = None) by (unfold im_sel; rewrite Hh'; reflexivity).
        assert (Hsb : im_sel Mj = Some vm) by (unfold im_sel; rewrite Hhj; reflexivity).
        rewrite Hsa, Hsb.
        unfold im_ref in Href; rewrite Hh' in Href; injection Href as <- <-.
        rewrite Hq in HDq; injection HDq as <-.
        destruct (grp_tele_ass_vwrap _ Hass _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hh) as (D2 & Hq2 & Hvw); rewrite Hq in Hq2; injection Hq2 as <-.
        assert (Hnl : n < List.length vm)
          by (rewrite (vwrap_ok_length _ _ _ Hvw); apply List.nth_error_Some; unfold ind_member in HMn; congruence).
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' _ _ Hnl) as [b Hvb].

                   (cons_lookup_nodup_in _ _ _ Hnd Hin) HcB).

A view of the container's: its map, then the view's.
        destruct Hhm as (Is' & vm' & Hhj & _).
        pose proof (Hcoh m Mm qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' j Mj qv kv Is' vm' HMm Hh Hq HMi' Hvi HM Hhj) as Hvma.
        unfold view_map_at in Hvma; rewrite Hh' in Hvma.
        assert (Hsa : im_sel Mi' = Some vmv) by (unfold im_sel; rewrite Hh'; reflexivity).
        assert (Hsb : im_sel Mj = Some vm') by (unfold im_sel; rewrite Hhj; reflexivity).
        rewrite Hsa, Hsb.
        unfold im_ref in Href; rewrite Hh' in Href; injection Href as <- <-.
        destruct (grp_tele_ass_vwrap _ (valid_group_ass _ _ HgQ) _ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' Hh') as (D2 & Hq2 & Hvw2).
        rewrite HDq in Hq2; injection Hq2 as <-.
        assert (Hnl : n < List.length vmv)
          by (rewrite (vwrap_ok_length _ _ _ Hvw2); apply List.nth_error_Some; unfold ind_member in HMn; congruence).
        destruct (nth_error_lt_some' _ _ Hnl) as [a Hva].
        destruct (vwrap_ok_members _ _ _ Hvw2 n Mn a HMn Hva) as (Ma & HMa & Hnna & Hnamesa & Hcorra).
        assert (Hb : exists b, List.nth_error vm' n = Some b /\ List.nth_error vm a = Some b).
        { pose proof (f_equal (fun l => List.nth_error l n) Hvma) as E; cbn beta in E.
          rewrite !List.nth_error_map, Hva in E; cbn in E.
          destruct (List.nth_error vm' n) as [b |] eqn:Hb0; cbn in E; [| discriminate ].
          injection E as E; exists b; split; [ reflexivity | exact E ]. }
        destruct Hb as (b & Hvb' & Hvab).
        destruct (XE cross_member a b Hvab) as (Ma0 & Mb & HMa0 & Hvmb2).
        rewrite HMa in HMa0; injection HMa0 as <-.
        pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb2) as HMb.
        destruct (cross_refs a Ma b Mb Hvab HMa HMb) as [hdn kn pran prbn Ran Rbn].
        pose proof (HcvQ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' Hh' HDq) as HgD.
        pose proof (decl_typed_nodup _ _ _ (valid_group_typed _ _ HgD) _ _ HMn) as Hnd.
        apply (mk_cross_block_site rk (rk j) (Some vmv) (Some vm') n Mn a Ma b Mb hdn kn pran prbn).
        * cbn; exact (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ Hva).
        * cbn; exact (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ Hvb').
        * exact Hvab.
        * exact HMa.
        * exact HMb.
        * symmetry; exact Hnna.
        * symmetry; exact Hnamesa.
        * intros c gq gA Hin HcA; exact (cargs_kinds_of_corr _ _ _ (Hcorra c gq gA Hin HcA)).
        * intros c gq gB Hin HcB.
          exact (view_rank_ok_nest _ _ _ _ Hrk j Mj qv kv Is' vm' Dq n Mn b Mb c gq gB HM Hhj HDq HMn Hvb' HMb
                   (cons_lookup_nodup_in _ _ _ Hnd Hin) HcB).
        * exact Ran.
        * exact Rbn.
  Qed.

The Stuck Eliminators

By strong induction on the rank.
  Theorem cross_bot_all : forall j, cross_bot j.
  Proof.
    destruct (grp_tele_ass_rank _ Hass) as [rk Hrk].
    assert (H : forall r j, rk j < r -> cross_bot j).
    { induction r as [| r IH]; intros j Hj; [ lia |].
      apply (cross_bot_rank rk Hrk j); intros j' Hj'; apply IH; lia. }
    intros j; exact (H (S (rk j)) j ltac:(lia)).
  Qed.
